comment: The divisions each output takes are worked out at RCDCore.cc:304-318. With spread off the outputs run consecutively from the rotation point, masked by the highest division; with spread on and a highest division of 8 they come from the fixed table 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 12, 16 at RCDCore.cc:302, and at 16, 32 or 64 they are evenly spaced. The rotate jack is the only rotation control: there is no rotate knob on this module.
